title: An Omitted Mode Is a Rare Rule: The Sampling-Verification Danger Law in Continuous Code World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the Code World Model paradigm an LLM synthesizes an executable world model that a classical planner searches, and the model is accepted when it reproduces sampled transitions. We ask what that acceptance certifies in continuous control. We define the pipeline's danger as an expected risk and isolate its exact factor: the probability that N i.i.d. gate rollouts all miss a critical event of probability r is exactly (1-r)^N; an independent acceptance sample adds its budget to the exponent. On three hybrid instruments the accepted mode-blind model is exploited: the planner is pinned at the mode boundary at a regret of nearly the whole attainable return. We prove a localization budget, valid at boundary points: models with Lipschitz constant at most L differing by eta at a point disagree above tolerance eps on a region of volume at least kappa((eta-eps)/L)^(d+m); the discontinuous reset modes studied pay no such budget. translated_title: 被省略的模态是罕见规则：连续代码世界模型中的采样-验证危险定律
translated_abstract: 在代码世界模型范式中，大型语言模型合成一个可执行的世界模型，经典规划器对其进行搜索，当模型能够再现采样的转换时即被接受。我们探讨这种接受在连续控制中究竟证明了什么。我们将该流程的危险定义为预期风险，并精确分离出其关键因素：N个独立同分布的闸门展开全部错过概率为r的关键事件的概率恰好为(1-r)^N；一个独立的接受样本将其预算加到指数上。在三种混合仪器上，被接受的模态盲模型遭到利用：规划器被钉在模态边界处，遗憾几乎达到整个可获得的回报。我们证明了一个局部化预算，在边界点处有效：Lipschitz常数至多为L的模型，在一点处相差eta，在体积至少为kappa((eta-eps)/L)^(d+m)的区域上与容差eps以上不一致；所研究的非连续重置模态无需付出这种预算。借助真实的LLM合成...
tldr: 本文揭示了连续代码世界模型中，采样验证接受模型可能因省略罕见模态而导致规划器被利用，并提出了危险定律及局部化预算理论。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that in continuous code world models, sampling-verification acceptance can exploit models by omitting rare modes, proposing a danger law and localization budget.
